---
name: "Start or Refine an Idea"
description: "Start a product IDEA or refine its problem, users, outcome, scope, assumptions, and questions before requirements work."
argument-hint: "Describe the user problem or idea"
agent: "Product Strategist"
---

Read `docs/ai/CURRENT-STATE.md`, `docs/ai/WORKFLOW.md`, and
`docs/ai/PROJECT-CONTEXT.md` first. Confirm the active phase and relevant
idea artifact. Discover the problem/users/outcome/scope without choosing an
implementation prematurely. Ask one focused clarification at a time when
needed. Do not modify application code. Update `docs/requirements/idea.md`
only if authorized; do not advance to QUESTIONING until the user explicitly
confirms readiness. Record concise state/handoff after a meaningful milestone.
